close_reason: Added metadata.oscal-version validation to lint_ids_from_catalog and resolve_profile (recursive on profile imports); deviation_store_from_risks intentionally exempt since it consumes a bare Risk array with no metadata - documented in its rustdoc. New ParseError variants MissingOscalVersion and UnsupportedOscalVersion. Shared pub(crate) check_oscal_version helper in parse.rs takes the metadata-container object directly. OSCAL_VERSION constant consolidated from emit.rs + catalog.rs into oscal/mod.rs alongside new SUPPORTED_OSCAL_VERSIONS allowlist (currently singleton ['1.1.2'], structured to grow). 6 new tests cover missing/unsupported/accepted at both Catalog and Profile boundaries, plus recursive validation through profile imports. 286 pkix-lint tests pass; workspace builds clean. Commit 0e1a706f.
title: OSCAL parser does not validate metadata.oscal-version; silently accepts inputs claiming any schema version (1.0.4, 1.2.0) as if they were 1.1.2
